end.summary:
Practised ordering cell, tissue, organ, organ system, and organism.
Yash gave correct sequences in 2 of 4 attempts, including muscle and plant examples.
Discussed how connected parts affect the whole, using the circulatory system and roots as examples.
The organ/organism mix-up was revisited but was not fully corrected at the last check; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised the levels of organisation with muscle, plant, heart, and house examples. Yash worked through the order and explained that damaged roots can affect water movement, and that a problem in blood vessels can affect the heart and the whole body. The mix-up between organs and organisms came up again and was not fully settled by the end. At home, ask Yash to draw and label one chain—cell → tissue → organ → organ system → organism—and explain one way each level supports the next.
